description: AI Toolbase is a multilingual directory that helps users discover and compare AI projects across writing, coding, image, video, audio, and productivity categories. It provides a practical way to evaluate tools like ChatGPT alternatives and other AI products. The platform is useful for anyone looking to explore available AI solutions without marketing hype.
